entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to start a return for an order. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes about a month ago, and they're just not working out for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Got it, VF88612. I see the order was delivered 37 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's the fit. I've tried everything, adjusted the cleats multiple times, wore different socks, but they're still giving me terrible blisters on my heels after any ride longer than an hour.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters from new cycling shoes is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm our policy here.
Okay, I've checked. Since the shoes were delivered within the last 90 days, you are fully eligible for a return. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I did have to deal with the discomfort and the blisters, and now have to go through the process of sending them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

I understand your position, and I do apologize for the trouble you've had. However, our policy allows for the full refund, which I've processed, but I'm not authorized to issue an additional discount code in this situation.
Alright, I thought I'd ask. The refund is the most important part. So what are the next steps?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just box up the cycling shoes, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be credited back to your original payment method.
Perfect. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find a better-fitting pair of shoes for you in the future. Have a great day.
